raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

Fixes #44054.

`test/registered/kernels/ops/gemm/test_pi05_modelopt_fp8_cuda.py` imports `sglang.multimodal_gen`, which needs the `diffusion` extra (`imageio`, ...). It is registered in the `base-b` / `1-gpu-small` lane of `PR Test Base`, which installs only `python[dev,runai,tracing]`. On runners whose CI venv does not already have `imageio`, the test fails at import with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'imageio'`, for example in #42760 ([job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38384431344/job/115259669168)) and #34502 ([job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38378074749/job/115245167435)).

## Modifications

Register the test with `stage="base-b-kernel-unit"` instead of `stage="base-b"`, keeping `runner_config="1-gpu-small"`. The kernel-unit lane (`pr-test-jit-kernel.yml`) runs `ci_install_dependency.sh diffusion`, and every other CUDA test that imports `sglang.multimodal_gen` already registers there or on a diffusion runner.

Trade-off: the kernel-unit lane runs on PRs that touch JIT-kernel paths and on scheduled `main` runs, not on every PR.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: CI registration change only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). `pre-commit run --all-files` passes, including "validate registered test CI registries".
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). Not applicable.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not applicable.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Validation: the AST collector (`collect_tests`) resolves the test to suite `base-b-kernel-unit-test-1-gpu-small`, which is in `run_suite.py`'s list of valid CUDA suites. The test itself was not run locally.
